title: Climate Change is a Hoax - Scientists Debunk Global Warming

claims.text: Global temperatures have not increased in the last 20 years.
claims.explanation: NASA data shows 2023 was the hottest year on record. The last 10 years are the warmest in 125,000 years.

claims.text: CO2 levels are natural and have been much higher in Earth's history.
claims.explanation: Partially true - CO2 has been higher, but NOT during human civilization. Current CO2 levels are the highest in 800,000 years.

claims.text: 97% of climate scientists agree that human activity is causing climate change.
claims.explanation: This is accurate - multiple peer-reviewed studies confirm the scientific consensus.

claims.text: Renewable energy costs more than fossil fuels and doesn't reduce emissions.
claims.explanation: False. Solar and wind are now cheaper than coal in most countries. They significantly reduce emissions.

claims.text: Sea levels are rising at an accelerating rate due to ice melt.
claims.explanation: Accurate. NASA data confirms sea levels have risen 4 inches since 1993 with accelerating rates.

trust_score_description: Low - Only 2 out of 5 claims are properly sourced
